# Bhavya Computer Classes - Full Context

> Government-certified computer training institute in Kota, Rajasthan.

## About Us
Bhavya Computer Classes (BCI Kota) is a premier computer education institute established in 2010. We offer placement-assisted training programs in various software and digital skills. We are the only computer institute in Kota with a digital student portal, offering government-recognised certificates and 100% placement assistance. Over 15 years, we have trained 5,000+ students.

## Key Information
- **Location**: 3-N-25, Mahaveer Nagar Extension, Near Ganesh Ji Mandir, Kota, Rajasthan, 324005, India
- **Phone**: +91-9694932391 / +91-9694025249
- **Website**: https://www.bhavyacomputerclasses.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 AM - 07:00 PM
- **Batch Sizes**: Small batches of 10-15 students for personalized attention.

## Our Courses
1. **DCA (Diploma in Computer Applications)**: Core computer skills (6 months to 1 year). Covers MS Office, Internet, Tally, programming basics. Government-recognised certificate.
2. **Tally Prime with GST**: Professional accounting software training, covering GST return filing, voucher entry, inventory management, and payroll.
3. **Python Programming**: Fundamentals to advanced Python for software development, highly valued for remote and freelance work.
4. **Web Designing & Development**: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks.
5. **RSCIT**: Government-recognized basic computer literacy course, mandatory for most Rajasthan government jobs.
6. **Digital Marketing**: Online advertising, SEO, social media marketing, email campaigns, and Google Ads.
7. **Advanced Excel**: Deep dive into spreadsheet analysis.
8. **Graphic Design**: Photoshop, Illustrator, and design principles.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the admission process at Bhavya Computer Classes?**
You can enroll by visiting our campus in Mahaveer Nagar Extension, Kota, or by calling/WhatsApp-ing us at +91 96949 32391. We also offer an online inquiry form on our Contact page. Admission is open throughout the year — new batches start every month.

**Do you provide placement assistance after course completion?**
Yes! We provide 100% placement assistance to all our students. We have tie-ups with local businesses, accounting firms, and IT companies in Kota and nearby cities.

**Can I attend a free demo class before enrolling?**
Absolutely! We offer 2 free demo classes for all our courses — no payment or commitment required.

**What is the fee structure for the courses?**
Course fees vary depending on the program. Short-term courses like Basic Computer and Tally start from approximately ₹3,000. We also offer flexible instalment plans.

**Do you offer weekend batches for working professionals?**
Yes! We have special weekend batches (Saturday & Sunday) designed specifically for working professionals, homemakers, and anyone who can't attend on weekdays.

**What is the student portal and how does it help me?**
Our student portal is a digital learning environment unique to Bhavya Computer Classes. You can view your attendance, check test marks, submit assignments digitally, and download study material.

**Can I get a government job after completing a course from Bhavya?**
Yes! Our RSCIT and DCA certificates are recognised for Rajasthan state government job applications.

## Conclusion
Bhavya Computer Classes focuses on practical, hands-on learning to ensure students are job-ready. We offer a blend of traditional classroom teaching and modern digital resources to provide the best educational experience in Kota.
